quantified_scope: For every natural l, there exist rational delta > 0 and a natural N. For n >= N and A contained in [1,n], if A.card > n/2 + n/3 - n/6 and (A minus standardUniverse n).card <= delta*n, then A contains K_(1,l,l) in its coprimality graph.
near_assumption: The positive-density upper bound on A minus U(n), U(n) = {1 <= v <= n : 2 divides v or 3 divides v}, remains required.
limitations: The near theorem does not handle sets farther from U(n).
The complete second-question conclusion still requires a complementary far branch or another valid reduction.
Thresholds and density constants are extremely large; no numerical efficiency is claimed.
